comment: Read from the installed 2.0.5 build. Q962_process holds a stage number, sets it directly from each trigger input or button and advances it on a rising edge at the shift jack, taking the remainder against three or two according to a flag in the state, which is what makes the switch two-way when only two signals are in use. The signal jacks are given no family because a switch carries whatever is given to it; the trigger outputs are triggers.
